delta_note: Minimum meaningful accuracy difference in the interaction. Given a priori and signed off by the operator at Freeze-1. The exploration round's variance is used ONLY for sample size and power; it may never be used to revise delta (§9.1).

outcomes.material_difference: the 95% CI of D lies entirely above +delta or entirely below -delta
outcomes.equivalent: the 90% CI of D lies entirely inside [-delta, +delta] -> SC2
outcomes.inconclusive: otherwise -> SC3; do not add samples, change endpoint, or change delta

parseability_threshold_note: Per condition, per model. Below this the cell is reported as a feasibility result; the denominator is NOT reduced and no prefill or parser change is applied (§9.4). Fact F4 (240/240 unparseable under the predecessor's raw-direct route) is why this threshold is registered in advance.
endpoints: conditional_accuracy (labelled conditional; never substituted into the estimand)
